answer.explanation: Starting with $150,000 at a monthly interest rate of 0.5% (6% annual nominal compounded monthly), the initial balance grows to $496,530.67 at month 240. The $1,000 monthly contributions for months 1–120 grow to $298,161.55 by month 240. The $1,500 monthly contributions for months 121–240 grow to $245,819.02 by month 240. The $30,000 withdrawal at month 180 reduces the month-240 balance by $40,465.50. This yields a projected month-240 total balance of $1,000,045.74. The shortfall relative to the $1,200,000 target is $199,954.26. To accumulate this shortfall over 240 months at 0.5% per month, an exact additional monthly end-of-month contribution of $432.76313171501 is required, which rounds upward to $432.77 per month.
